title: Microsoft 365 Backup: longer recovery windows for SharePoint and OneDrive, up to 10 years
notes: claim 72: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The recovery windows, unchanged default, pricing, and control paths and APIs are supported. Hold for an overbroad administrator-role statement: Microsoft 365 Backup Administrator manages SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange, but does not grant Entra backup management privileges. The statement that end users see no app changes also lacks explicit documentation.
